decisions.reason: After only one year on the market, demand is still being learned and a medium-sized German machinery firm would usually keep a newly launched injection unit as a live option unless clear negative evidence appears.

Because it overlaps with another two-component resin injection unit, it faces some pruning risk, but with uncertainty still high in 2019 the firm would likely keep it on offer for another year to compare market response.
An automatic airless spray gun fits the firm's coating-equipment portfolio, and the option value of continuing to observe customer uptake likely exceeds the short-term cost of keeping it listed.

The manual airless spray gun is somewhat more exposed to later rationalization because it may be a lower-differentiated variant, but one year is still early for abandonment without stronger failure signals.
As a distinct spray-gun variant, it adds portfolio breadth and the firm would likely preserve that option while uncertainty about segment demand remains unresolved.
The data logger is a complementary digital product whose market potential may take time to reveal, so management would usually keep it available unless early adoption had clearly disappointed.
